summary: Baird Medical Investment Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, reporting preliminary unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenue was approximately $9.9 million, up 24.6% year-over-year, with net income of about $14,000 versus an $11.4 million loss in the prior-year period. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by the foreign private issuer and does not involve any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The press release is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms, board recommendations, or event-driven actions are present; this is an ordinary periodic financial disclosure.
